# Windows Development

</div>

Windows development is available in ARDK 3.0 as an experimental feature.

<div class="theme-admonition theme-admonition-tip admonition_xJq3 alert alert--success">

<div class="admonitionHeading_Gvgb">

<span class="admonitionIcon_Rf37">![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)</span>Important!

</div>

<div class="admonitionContent_BuS1">

Features in Windows may display unexpected behavior or not function entirely. If you find an issue that is not listed on this page, please join us in the <a href="https://community.lightship.dev/c/bugs/5" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Lightship Developer Community</a> to provide feedback.

</div>

</div>

## Known Issues<a href="#known-issues" class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to Known Issues" title="Direct link to Known Issues">​</a>

- Playback works in Windows, but Recording does not. To use Playback in Windows, you will need to record on another platform.
- Building projects for iOS with ARDK is not supported on Windows.

</div>

</div>
